2.name: Episode 1
2.overview: Claudia Winkleman welcomes a brand new group of celebrities as they arrive at a beautiful castle in the Scottish Highlands to play the ultimate reality game of detection, back-stabbing and trust.

2.name: Episode 2
2.overview: As the ultimate reality game of detection, treachery and trust continues, the Traitors complete their line-up, and the celebrities have to dig deep in the mission.

2.name: Episode 3
2.overview: As the first banishment unfolds, the Faithful are hoping that they’ve caught a Traitor, while the Traitors are desperate to keep their identities concealed.

2.name: Episode 4
2.overview: As the players go deeper into the game, a new day brings new suspicions amongst the Faithful. The mission forces the celebrities to work in teams under terrifying conditions.

2.name: Episode 5
2.overview: As suspense fills the air, the burning question is, who has been murdered, and will the answer help to reveal a Traitor? In the mission, the celebrity players come face to face with death.

2.name: Episode 6
2.overview: As the celebrity players gather for breakfast, conspiracies are running wild. The games continue in a mission where one mistake could cause heads to roll. At the Round Table, suspicions continue to rise - can the Traitors deflect accusations, or will the Faithful see through their lies?

2.name: Episode 7
2.overview: As a new day dawns, breakfast brings a fresh shock for the Faithful. In the mission, the celebrity players are taken to a mysterious location where the Traitors must work as a team.

2.name: Episode 8
2.overview: As fewer players remain in the game, the pressure mounts for all the celebrities. In the morning, speculation is rife - will everyone turn up for breakfast?

2.name: Episode 9
2.overview: As the Round Table draws to a close, another celebrity player is banished - but are they a Faithful or a Traitor?

2.name: Finale
2.overview: As the ultimate game of deception and trust draws to a close, the stakes have never been higher as the celebrity players face their final, explosive mission. With the prize fund complete, will the pressure of winning cloud anyone’s vision? Will the Faithful banish all of the Traitors to secure victory, or will the Traitors manage to deceive until the bitter end?
